confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors come from aggregator and travel-site estimates that disagree with each other, so they are bounded rather than precise. Beer and coffee are the best-supported anchors. Cocktail and wine are weaker: the cocktail anchor is a bounded estimate between Jeonju's lower prices and Seoul's ranges, and the wine anchor is set from the beer price using a local price multiple of roughly 2.5 to 3 times. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and regional context. I did not inspect live booking pages or current listings. FX: the RBA observation is the 20 March 2026 figure, which is the most recent RBA-attributed value I could confirm. Later news reports cite an RBA 4pm reference of about 0.6976 on 3 November 2026, but I could not verify that on rba.gov.au, so I did not use it. Retrieve the latest F11 observation from rba.gov.au before relying on the FX basis.
comparable_city_reasoning: Mid-sized South Korean provincial city, priced below Seoul for food and drink. Restaurant and drink levels are set from Seoul-area aggregator data and reduced for a smaller regional market. Accommodation is set from general knowledge of Korean provincial guesthouse, hostel and hotel tiers.
